nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the future companion receipt bind the complete snapshot cost input set
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The record pins the companion tool, model, discovery tool, member model, sealing and ledger. This is enough to identify the requested companion-tool bytes, but is not by itself the complete snapshot cost-source closure: census() discards snapshot_costs() returned source pins, and the capture-session source set and identity bound/encoding sources are also outside this six-row list. The current exact subject and reviewed lead-readable results are valid; no companion blind receipt is claimed here. The next blind unit should not treat these six pins alone as a complete enduring binding to the native recipe.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: In the separately reviewed blind unit, bind the complete snapshot walk/session/sealing and bound-source closure, directly or through hash-bound vector/model records that contain those pins, and check freshness before accepting a receipt. Explicitly distinguish that complete set from the current record's tool pins.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Check census row identity coverage in addition to the manifest hash
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The margin test compares manifest hashes, then checks rows and aggregate counts supplied by the snapshot record itself. It does not compare the actual ID sets with discovery's lead-readable repositories/workspaces or reject duplicates. A truncated record with updated counts could retain the same manifest hash and pass this test. Independent inspection confirms the current record covers all 39 lead-readable repositories and five workspaces exactly and in order, so this is not a current census omission.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Compare the snapshot record's unique ID sets with the corresponding lead-readable rows in the compiled discovery record, keeping stale held-out rows excluded. This makes the test enforce its stated coverage property independently.
